concept: oMLX paged SSD cache auto limit policy
summary: `CacheSettings.ssd_cache_max_size` defaults to `"auto"` with the comment `"auto" reserves half of available cache space`.

facts.text: `CacheSettings.ssd_cache_max_size` defaults to `"auto"` with the comment `"auto" reserves half of available cache space`.
`get_auto_ssd_cache_size` returns `(free_bytes + cache_bytes) // 2`, where `cache_bytes` sums `*.safetensors` files under the directories `0123456789abcdef` and `_gdn_sidecars`, skipping symlinks.
`get_ssd_cache_max_size_bytes` returns `get_auto_ssd_cache_size(cache_dir)` for `"auto"` and `parse_size(...)` otherwise.
The environment variable `OMLX_SSD_CACHE_MAX_SIZE` overrides the setting, and validation accepts `"auto"` or a positive parsed size.
`CacheSettings.from_dict` replaces a hot-cache size of `"auto"` with `"0"`, and settings validation says hot-cache `'auto' is not supported`.
In v0.6.4, `get_ssd_cache_max_size_bytes` returned `int(get_ssd_capacity(cache_dir) * 0.1)` for `"auto"`, with the docstring "10% of SSD if auto".
`get_ssd_capacity` returns `shutil.disk_usage(...).total` for the nearest existing path and assumes 500 GB if detection fails.
In v0.6.4, `_get_effective_max_size` returned `min(self._max_size, int((tracked_size + disk_free) * 0.99))` using a 30-second disk-usage cache.

On main, `_get_effective_max_size` returns `disk_available // 2` in auto mode and `min(self._max_size, int(disk_available * 0.99))` otherwise, where `disk_available` is the cache size sampled with the free-space reading plus that free space.
The docstring says sampling both sizes together "keeps writes from increasing the cached budget"; the disk-usage snapshot is reused for 30 seconds.
`PagedSSDCacheManager.__init__` takes `auto_size: bool = False` documented as "Use 50% of the sum of free space and existing SSD cache", and logs `auto_size=` at startup.

`_enforce_size_limit_for_new_block` sets `target_size = effective_max - estimated_new_size`, falls back to 90% of the limit if negative, caps inline eviction at `_MAX_INLINE_UNLINKS_PER_SAVE = 32` unless `unbounded`, and warns about disk pressure only when `not self._auto_size`.
`_evict_tracked_until_size` walks the compatible, incompatible and GDN sidecar indexes in one LRU order, breaking ties in that fixed order.
On ENOSPC or EDQUOT during a write, the manager logs "SSD cache disk full" and sets `_disk_usage_cache = None` so the next save recomputes free space.

Commit 0faa19c changes the macOS app and README text from "auto = 10% of SSD capacity" to "50% of the sum of free space and existing SSD cache", adds `paged_ssd_cache_auto_size` to the scheduler config and `ssd_cache_auto_size_bytes` to the settings-defaults response.

The README note added by 0faa19c says the default `auto` uses 50% of the sum of free disk space and existing SSD cache files, including GDN sidecars, refreshed during use and not shrinking because the cache grows or the server restarts.
Issue 3829 was opened on 2026-09-22 by a user on an M2 Max 32 GB with 10 GB free, oMLX 0.6.4 from Homebrew, macOS 15, with the default `"ssd_cache_max_size": "auto"`.

The maintainer's formula is `Cache limit = (free disk space + existing SSD cache) x 50%`, and the maintainer measured 3.22 GiB added by four distinct 8,192-token requests with 128-token outputs, about 53% in GDN sidecars, on Qwen3.8-27B 4-bit with memory detection set to 32 GB.
The reporter corrected the figure: 6.5 GB was from 8 requests over two `omlx serve` sessions, so 0.81 GB per request, matching the maintainer's rate.

The 0.7.0rc1 release notes list "Safer automatic SSD-cache sizing", basing automatic capacity on available disk space and including offline GDN sidecars in cache maintenance, crediting issues 3829 and 3883.
On a Mac with 10 GB free and an empty cache, the new `auto` limit is 5 GB, where v0.6.4 allowed up to about 99% of free space.
